## GHL v2 - Daily Lead Digest
Runs every day at **09:00 Asia/Dhaka** (timezone is set in workflow Settings).

Reads `Leads_v2`, keeps rows whose `last_seen` is within 24h, sends one Telegram message (counts per tier + warm/cold list) or a short "no new leads" note.

Set the Google + Telegram credentials, replace `__SHEET_ID__` and `__TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID__`, then activate.
